subject: Q3 request: budget-neutral conversion of contractor hours into 2 senior runtime/platform roles
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Q3 request: budget-neutral conversion of contractor hours into 2 senior runtime/platform roles

Team —

As we head into Q3 we have an immediate operational gap on the runtime side: recurring incidents tied to KV cache eviction behavior and onboarding latency for large models. The infra team has been covering with 0.8 FTE from our contractor pool (two contractors ~60 hrs/wk combined), but this is not sustainable for production SLAs.

Request: convert the equivalent contractor budget into two full-time senior hires (Senior Runtime Engineer x1, Senior Platform SWE x1) starting in Q3. I believe this can be done in a cost-neutral way for the Q3 budget by:
- re-allocating the contractor line (details in attached finmodel),
- delaying two lower-priority requisitions in Platform until Q4, and
- offering a conservative comp band alignment (below mid-market, also attached).

Why this matters:
- Observable improvement in tail latency is contingent on dedicated ownership of KV cache strategy and production kernel tuning.
- Replacing contractors with permanent engineers reduces onboarding churn and knowledge loss during handoffs.
- We have a near-ready candidate (external recruiter intro, Sean O'Neill) who can start early and has specific experience with attention-kernel optimizations.

Attachments: Q3-conversion-finmodel.xlsx, comp-band-comparison.pdf

Ask: Kimberly — provisional budget sign-off if the attached model checks out. Marcus/Soojin — can you confirm the role split and priority? Aditya — confirm comp bands and time-to-fill estimate.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Manager, Platform Runtime
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Q3 request: budget-neutral conversion of contractor hours into 2 senior runtime/platform roles

Irene —

Thanks for the clear ask and the attachments. I ran a quick pass on the finmodel: the headcount shift looks achievable on paper but I need to confirm a couple of assumptions:
- Does the model assume contractors will be offboarded immediately (savings realized in May) or phased?
- The proposal defers two requisitions — which ones specifically (team + level)? We need to ensure there is no downstream impact on delivery commitments.

If those two items check out, I can provisionally reallocate the contractor line and mark this green pending HR band confirmation. Please add the two reqs into HRREQ-4827 so we have an audit trail.

Kimberly
